title: Bridge Slam Contract Accuracy
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bridgebase:board contract_level>=6
| eval made_contract=if(result_points>=0,1,0)
| stats sum(made_contract) as made, count as slam_bids by partnership_name
| eval made_pct=round(100*made/slam_bids,1)
| sort - made_pct
description: Measures how often slam-level bridge contracts are actually made by each partnership.
value: Slam judgment is high-leverage and memorable, which makes it useful as a focused improvement lens.
implementation: Parse BBO board records for contract level and result, then track slam make percentage by partnership.
visualization: Table of partnerships with slam bid count and make percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which bridge pairs are good at judging big ambitious contracts and which ones are overreaching.
